Method of Attack: Remote code execution vulnerability exploited to deploy web shells on vulnerable servers

Exploits Spring4Shell vulnerability by sending specially crafted queries to servers running the Spring Core framework to create web shells in the Tomcat root directory, allowing execution of commands on the compromised server
Discoverer: U.S. Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA)
Impacted Systems: Spring Framework versions 5.2.0 to 5.2.19 and earlier versions
Apache Tomcat as the Servlet container
Standalone Tomcat instances with packaged traditional Java web archive (WAR)
Systems with spring-webmvc or spring-webflux dependencies
Attack Vector: Sending specially crafted HTTP queries exploiting Spring Core framework vulnerability
Exploitation via specially crafted queries to Spring Core framework servers
Indicators of Compromise: HTTP 400 response to curl host:port/path?class.module.classLoader.URLs%5B0%5D=0 indicating vulnerability to publicly available proof of concept exploit
Exploit attempts detected targeting cloud services
Approximately 37,000 exploitation attempts detected over a weekend
